title: Guruji Talim Ganpati
text:
Guruji Talim Ganpati (गुरुजी तालीम गणपती) — 3 (Tisra Manacha), located in Laxmi Road, Budhwar Peth, Pune, established 1887.

History: Guruji Talim Ganpati was established in 1887 — six years before Tilak's 1893 Sarvajanik Ganeshotsav — making it one of Pune's very first public Ganesh mandals. It was founded jointly by Ustad Nalban (Muslim) and Bhiku Shinde (Hindu); this Hindu-Muslim partnership made the mandal a powerful symbol of communal harmony. It is also credited with originating the dhol-tasha procession tradition, now inseparable from Ganeshotsav across Maharashtra. Located near Alka Talkies on Laxmi Road, it holds the third Manacha position.

Idol/Deity: No single permanent idol feature — celebrated for community spirit and secular roots; dhol-tasha performances are its most iconic aspect.

Temple/Mandir address: 184, Laxmi Road, near Alka Talkies, Tulshibaug, Budhwar Peth, Pune 411002. Festival pandal address: TO UPDATE — confirm 2026 pandal location via mandal's social media. Maps link: TO UPDATE — check Guruji Talim Mandal pages in August 2026. Coordinates: 18.5163, 73.8558.

Aarti timings — Morning: Mangala Aarti: 7:30 AM; Evening: Sayan Aarti: 7:30 PM.

Special events during the 10 days: Cultural events from 6 PM daily; space-themed decorations (2025); dhol-tasha competitions.
